---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div style="display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px;">
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" id="opMode">
    Operator Mode
  </label>

  <input id="filter" placeholder="filter node e.g. GB7FCI" />
</div>

<div id="cy" style="width:100%; height:90vh; border:1px solid #ddd;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.26.0/dist/cytoscape.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let cy;

/* ---------------------------
   PORT COLOURS (your spec)
----------------------------*/
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "3": return "#1f77b4"; // AXIP (blue)
    case "1": return "#2ca02c"; // RF (green)
    case "2": return "#ffbf00"; // telnet/internal (amber)
    default:  return "#999999";
  }
}

/* ---------------------------
   NODE LABEL
   IMPORTANT: id = callsign
   alias = display only
----------------------------*/
function nodeLabel(n) {
  return n.alias && n.alias.length > 0
    ? `${n.id}\n${n.alias}`
    : n.id;
}

/* ---------------------------
   SAFE GRAPH NORMALISATION
   prevents Cytoscape crashes
----------------------------*/
function normaliseGraph(data) {
  const nodes = new Map();

  // add nodes
  for (const n of data.nodes) {
    nodes.set(n.id, {
      data: {
        id: n.id,
        label: nodeLabel(n)
      }
    });
  }

  // ensure edge endpoints exist
  const edges = [];
  for (const e of data.edges) {

    if (!nodes.has(e.source)) {
      nodes.set(e.source, {
        data: { id: e.source, label: e.source }
      });
    }

    if (!nodes.has(e.target)) {
      nodes.set(e.target, {
        data: { id: e.target, label: e.target }
      });
    }

    edges.push({
      data: {
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        port: e.port || e.type || "3",
        quality: e.quality || 0
      }
    });
  }

  return {
    elements: [
      ...nodes.values(),
      ...edges
    ]
  };
}

/* ---------------------------
   STYLE HELPERS
----------------------------*/
function nodeColor(label) {
  const l = label.toUpperCase();

  if (l.includes("BBS")) return "#d62728";
  if (l.includes("CHAT")) return "#9467bd";
  if (l.includes("NODE")) return "#17a2b8";

  return "#444";
}

/* ---------------------------
   RENDER GRAPH
----------------------------*/
function render(data) {

  const graph = normaliseGraph(data);

  cy = cytoscape({
    container: document.getElementById('cy'),

    elements: graph.elements,

    layout: {
      name: 'cose',
      animate: true,
      fit: true,
      padding: 40
    },

    style: [

      /* nodes */
      {
        selector: 'node',
        style: {
          'label': 'data(label)',
          'font-size': 10,
          'text-wrap': 'wrap',
          'text-valign': 'center',
          'text-halign': 'center',

          'background-color': ele => nodeColor(ele.data('label')),

          'width': 28,
          'height': 28,
          'border-width': 1,
          'border-color': '#ccc'
        }
      },

      /* edges */
      {
        selector: 'edge',
        style: {
          'curve-style': 'bezier',

          'line-color': ele => portColor(ele.data('port')),
          'target-arrow-color': ele => portColor(ele.data('port')),
          'target-arrow-shape': 'triangle',

          'width': ele => Math.max(1, (ele.data('quality') || 0) / 60),

          'opacity': 0.8
        }
      }

    ]
  });

  setupUI();
}

/* ---------------------------
   UI FILTER + OP MODE
----------------------------*/
function setupUI() {

  const filter = document.getElementById("filter");
  const opMode = document.getElementById("opMode");

  function apply() {

    const f = filter.value.toUpperCase();
    const op = opMode.checked;

    cy.nodes().forEach(n => {

      const id = n.id().toUpperCase();
      const label = (n.data('label') || "").toUpperCase();

      let show = true;

      if (f && !(id.includes(f) || label.includes(f))) {
        show = false;
      }

      if (op && n.degree() === 0) {
        show = false;
      }

      n.style("display", show ? "element" : "none");
    });

    cy.edges().forEach(e => {
      const s = e.source().style("display");
      const t = e.target().style("display");

      e.style("display",
        (s === "element" && t === "element") ? "element" : "none"
      );
    });
  }

  filter.addEventListener("input", apply);
  opMode.addEventListener("change", apply);
}

/* ---------------------------
   LOAD DATA
----------------------------*/
fetch(API)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => render(data))
  .catch(err => {
    console.error(err);
    document.getElementById("cy").innerHTML =
      "<p style='color:red'>Graph load failed</p>";
  });

</script>
